name: Project Scaffold & Configuration
description: Bootstraps the exemplar-tools-doc project: package.json with all dependencies (react, react-dom, react-router-dom, vite, tailwindcss, vitest, @testing-library/react, jsdom), vite.config.ts (port 4000), tsconfig.json (strict mode), tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, index.html entry point, vercel.json with SPA rewrites, and the main App.tsx shell that sets up BrowserRouter. All config files only — no page content. Named exports only per SOP for application source files. Config files are tool-mandated and exempt from the named-export SOP.

functions.name: App
functions.description: Root React function component. Renders a BrowserRouter wrapping a container div with id='app-shell'. Children and routes are injected by the downstream routing_and_layout component. Exported as a named export from src/App.tsx. Must NOT be a default export.

error_cases.name: missing_react_router
error_cases.condition: react-router-dom is not installed or importable.

preconditions: React 18 runtime is available in the module scope.
postconditions: Returns a React element tree with BrowserRouter at the root.
The rendered DOM contains a div with id='app-shell' inside the BrowserRouter.
The component is available as a named export: `import { App } from './App'`.
No default export exists on the module.

structured_side_effects.description: Pure function component — no side effects. Returns JSX tree only.

functions.name: mountApp
functions.description: Side-effect entry point in src/main.tsx. Imports { App } from './App', imports './index.css' for Tailwind styles, calls createRoot on the DOM element with id='root', and renders <App />. This module has no named exports — it executes on import as the Vite entry point referenced by index.html.

error_cases.name: missing_root_element
error_cases.condition: No DOM element with id='root' found in the document.

error_cases.name: app_import_failure
error_cases.condition: Named export { App } not found in ./App module.

preconditions: DOM element with id='root' exists in index.html.
src/App.tsx exports { App } as a named export.
postconditions: React application is mounted into the #root DOM element.
Tailwind base/components/utilities styles are injected into the document.
No named exports exist on this module — it is a side-effect-only entry point.
side_effects: Mounts React tree to DOM #root element

structured_side_effects.description: Calls createRoot and render to attach the React component tree to the #root DOM node.
Imports Tailwind CSS directive file as a side effect to inject styles into the document.

invariants: All application source files (.ts, .tsx) use TypeScript strict mode as enforced by tsconfig.json strict: true.

All application source files use named exports only — no default exports. Config files (package.json, vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, vercel.json) are exempt from this rule as they are tool-mandated.
Vite dev server always listens on port 4000.
Vitest uses jsdom environment with globals enabled and setupFiles pointing to src/test-setup.ts.
tsconfig.json uses jsx: 'react-jsx', moduleResolution: 'bundler', and isolatedModules: true.
postcss.config.js includes tailwindcss and autoprefixer plugins.

index.html contains
and .
vercel.json contains a single rewrite rule: { source: '/(.*)', destination: '/index.html' } for SPA client-side routing.
src/index.css contains exactly: @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities;
src/test-setup.ts imports '@testing-library/jest-dom' to register custom DOM matchers globally.
package.json lists react, react-dom, and react-router-dom as runtime dependencies (caret-pinned to their major versions).

package.json lists vite, vitest, tailwindcss, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, jsdom, @vitejs/plugin-react, typescript, autoprefixer, and postcss as devDependencies (all caret-pinned).
The App component renders a BrowserRouter at its root with a child div having id='app-shell'.
No page content, route definitions, or layout components are defined by this scaffold — those are the responsibility of downstream components.

data_access.rationale: The scaffold reads and writes only PUBLIC-tier data: static configuration files (package.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, vercel.json, index.html) and boilerplate application entry points (App.tsx, main.tsx, index.css, test-setup.ts). No user data, PII, secrets, or internal API details are accessed. All artifacts are committed to version control and publicly visible in the repository.

side_effects.rationale: Generates project configuration files that define build tooling, TypeScript compiler options, CSS processing pipeline, dev server settings, and deployment routing rules.
Generates application entry point source files: the root React component shell, the DOM mount script, the Tailwind CSS directive file, and the test setup file for jest-dom matchers.
Generates the contract test file that verifies the App component renders correctly with router context and uses named exports.

authority.rationale: This component is the sole authority for all project-level configuration and infrastructure: package.json dependency manifest, TypeScript compiler settings, Vite build/dev-server config, Tailwind/PostCSS styling pipeline, Vercel deployment routing, vitest test environment setup, and the root application shell. No other component may modify these files. Downstream components consume the infrastructure this scaffold provides but do not own or alter it.
